title: Source bootstrap seed
description: Explicit selectors remain source candidates. Provenance URL content requires separate review; no invented city, airport or timezone defaults.

name.description: Must contain a name after Unicode alphanumeric normalization and match a source city/town name or name:en.

cityOsmRef.description: Selects only among matching named city/town nodes in the verified PBF.

ident.description: Exact unique pinned CSV ident; same-country named airport with scheduled_service=yes required. Municipality may differ.

sourceUrl.description: Caller-reviewed HTTPS source supporting this airport serves the selected city.

id.description: Exact unique IANA zone.tab id among rows for countryISO.

sourceUrl.description: Caller-reviewed HTTPS source supporting this city's timezone selection.

provenanceUrl.description: Runtime additionally requires a hostname and rejects embedded credentials.
